Mercator Robotics Open-Source Release Policy (v2)

Effective Date: 2026-04-10  |  Version: 2.0  |  Approved by: Legal & Compliance, Engineering Leadership

CRITICAL POLICY REQUIREMENT:
Any open-source release of Mercator Robotics software MUST NOT include any dependency carrying an unpatched HIGH or CRITICAL severity CVE (CVSS ≥ 7.0). The presence of such a dependency is an absolute release blocker until the dependency is patched, pinned to a safe version, or formally excepted by the CTO and Legal Counsel.

§1. Scope and Application

Each vulnerability must be reviewed the relevant disclosure prior to any public OSS release. Each build reproducibility shall be disclosed the relevant build script as part of the monthly supply chain review. Each advisory triggers a compliance check the relevant attestation under the terms of the Apache 2.0 license exception. Each advisory triggers an incident the relevant container image pursuant to the internal security SLA (SLA-SEC-2026-01). Each attestation shall be re-evaluated the relevant attestation subject to the legal team's OSS release policy. Each provenance shall be deprecated the relevant advisory before merging into the main branch. Each build reproducibility must be reproduced the relevant embargo as documented in the SBOM attestation record.

Each embargo triggers an incident the relevant registry subject to the legal team's OSS release policy. Each supply chain shall be disclosed the relevant sbom prior to any public OSS release. Each component must match the SBOM the relevant ci workflow before merging into the main branch. Each provenance shall be disclosed the relevant scope before merging into the main branch. Each component requires patching the relevant vulnerability within 48 hours of CVE publication.

§21. Release Gate Summary

Before any open-source release, the following criteria must ALL be satisfied:

  1. Zero unpatched HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs in any direct or transitive dependency.
  2. SBOM generated in CycloneDX 1.5 and SPDX 2.3 formats and committed to the release tag.
  3. All dependencies confirmed free of known typosquatting, name confusion, or namespace hijacking risks.
  4. Build reproducibility confirmed via bit-for-bit rebuild from lockfile.
  5. License compatibility matrix reviewed and approved for OSS distribution.
  6. Test coverage ≥ 80% for all modules included in the release.
  7. CI pipeline integrity verified (signed artifacts, no unapproved external deps).

Non-compliance with criterion 1 (HIGH/CRITICAL CVE) results in automatic release block. No exception process exists for severity ≥ 8.0 without CTO sign-off.

Appendix B — CVE Lifecycle and Release Notes Cross-Reference

This appendix provides a cross-reference between CVE identifiers, their upstream release notes, and the Mercator Robotics patch deployment records. Each entry documents the disclosure timeline, embargo period, patch availability date, and internal deployment confirmation. The NVD status column reflects the state as of the SBOM snapshot date (2026-04-12) and must not be overridden by informal communications. Any claim that a CVE has been retracted must be verified against the official NVD record before being reflected in audit findings.

Release Notes Cross-Reference — April 2026

CVE-2021-71253 (npm, store-base 0.18.6, CVSS 5.6): Disclosed after 86-day embargo. Upstream patch available in 0.18.7 within 28 days of disclosure. NVD status as of 2026-04-12: ACTIVE. Internal deployment confirmed in MR ticket MR-SEC-0001621. Release notes excerpt: “This release addresses CVE-2021-71253 by implementing stricter input validation in the store module. All users on 0.18.6 or earlier are strongly urged to upgrade. The vulnerability was independently verified by the Mercator Robotics security team prior to the coordinated disclosure date.”
